verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox is a SaaS virtual-mailbox platform, so a versioned public API with a deprecation policy is a fair question for it, but the evidence shows no API at all. The docs cover only app and web-portal mail management, and the probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec (all candidate paths 404) and no llms.txt. Nothing mentions API versioning or a deprecation policy.
